gui.spark_fix.patch_monitor.singleplayer: Prevents a chat update on the wrong thread from leaving the game stuck when closing a single-player world.
Stops leftover TabTPS background tasks so its process can exit after the game window closes.
gui.spark_fix.patch_monitor.ali_wait.des: Skips requests an unsupported server cannot answer, avoiding a long freeze while recipes load.
gui.spark_fix.patch_monitor.chat_history: Helps Chat Patches save messages that contain item properties and similar information.
gui.spark_fix.patch_monitor.waypoint_upd: Recovers player waypoint updates with missing initial data or changed types, avoiding disconnects and stale positions.
gui.spark_fix.patch_monitor.locator.desc: Corrects Player Locator Plus 2.4.0 directions for distant players, separate location updates and front third-person view.
Uses a smaller font atlas when Axiom's Chinese font atlas does not fit, helping the editor stay usable.
gui.spark_fix.patch_monitor.axiom_labels: Adds Chinese text to labels such as Copy Air, Copy Entities and Keep Existing that bypass the translation table.
gui.spark_fix.patch_monitor.rei_placemen: Uses normal inventory clicks to place recipes when the server does not support REI's transfer requests.
gui.spark_fix.patch_monitor.boat_use.des: Allows eating and drinking while rowing, and clears stale rowing state after dismounting.
gui.spark_fix.patch_monitor.printer_scan: Stops invalid scan ranges and bounds work per scan, reducing long printer stalls on the game thread.
gui.spark_fix.patch_monitor.printer_conn: Avoid disconnects when starting a printer
Corrects how affected printers handle player status updates, avoiding immediate server disconnects.
gui.spark_fix.patch_monitor.printer_sett: Stores settings by printer source, restores them when switching back and includes options omitted by the original screen.
gui.spark_fix.patch_monitor.xaero_cleanu: Adds cleanup buttons for automatic deathpoints and found structures; restores data if saving fails.
Keeps received recipes for REI without reusing old session identifiers to place historical recipes.
gui.spark_fix.patch_monitor.rei_menus.de: Adjusts submenu position, clipping and tooltips so REI menus stay visible near screen edges.
gui.spark_fix.patch_monitor.litematica_p: Adds the improved settings entry to Litematica's main menu for its options and detected add-ons.

gui.spark_fix.structure_finder.treasure_: A chest at chunk-local X=9, Z=9, with sandstone, stone, andesite, granite or diorite below. The 124 surrounding blocks can be those stones, sand, gravel, dirt, grass blocks, clay, red sand or red sandstone; no sand majority is required. The similarity slider does not relax this rule; player-buried chests may match.

config.spark_fix.litematica_string_list_: Enter one value per field. The expected value depends on this setting; blank fields are not saved.
One allowed block per field: use a block ID, #tag, or stone,c for contains matching. Applies when mining restriction uses the whitelist.
One blocked block per field: use a block ID, #tag, or stone,c for contains matching. Applies when mining restriction uses the blacklist.
Enter one block ID per field, such as minecraft:stone. Do not include brackets or quotes.
Enter one allowed container block ID per field, such as minecraft:chest.
One rule per field: source block ID => target block ID. Separate multiple blocks with |. Toggle the printer off once after changes.
